{"notes": "Visit 4 (5:00-6:00). The picture shows every domino dark, so the whole fish is connected to the start, including the crossing. No hands were visible. I still can't say who placed which dominoes, so credit rests on what I saw and heard.

PRIYA: Silent this visit, and I saw nothing from her. Earlier notes still stand: accurate risk calls and strong awareness, but hands-on work unverified. Maya credits her with the fin. Ask her directly what she built.

TOM: Spotted the off-path crossing domino. He first planned a nudge, then judged it connected and chose not to touch it, then called hands-off. Restraint was sensible and the picture backs his connection claim. He flip-flopped, though, and 'by my look' is weaker than a verified check. He also left Leo's flagged domino unresolved. Good coordination of hands-off. Credit claims remain unverified.

LEO: His inspection independently flagged the same domino, which shows real attention to detail. At 5:45 he challenged the 'done' call, which is a good instinct, but it risked reopening a finished build with little time left. His conditional 'won't touch unless broken' was careful. The table stayed connected. He is more collaborative this visit (he offered to re-check with Tom), though he still hasn't taken up help.

MAYA: Her report (114/114 connected, final joint check, then hands-off) matched what I saw. Her attributions to others are fair. She still never names her own building work, so her impact is unverified. Ask her directly.

Overall: the team is calm and aligned, with the crossing joint the only loose end, and it appears resolved."}
